thread:
Mia: Heads-up — onboarding sample app 2.0 is flaking on function-calls when JSON mode is enabled. Repro steps in README but TL;DR: tool returns an array and our schema validator expects an object, app crashes on parse.
Sam: Ugh, seen that before. Is this the Python SDK or TS one?
Mia: TS samplekit (starter-templates/web-chat). Works fine with no-json-mode, but with --json-mode it throws: `TypeError: expected object, got array`.
Tony: CI-bot also flagged a regression in recent CI run. Kuan, do you have the failure id?
Kuan: CI-bot: build 4382 failed (test: samplekit-jsonmode). Error snippet pasted in the CI log.
CI-bot: build 4382 — failure in `samplekit-jsonmode-onboard.test.ts` at `should-coerce-tool-output`
Mia: The frustrating part: Node helper does an automatic coercion for legacy tool outputs, but the TS SDK helper in the samplekit tests runs the strict schema path. We have a parity gap.
Sam: Can you paste the model/tool output? Might be double-encoded JSON or an array wrapper.
Mia: Here — model returns: `[{"action":"upsert","items":[{"id":"x","text":"hi"}]}]` and our handler expects `{action: string, items: array}`.
Tony: So two options: 1) make the SDK helper in TS coerce arrays by taking first element if schema expects object, 2) update sample app tests to normalize before validation. Which is less risky?
Kuan: Option 1 is safer for onboarding—most users copy sample code. But we need a clear opt-in. We already have `jsonMode: 'strict' | 'loose'` in runtime config — maybe the SDK helper should respect that.
Sam: Agreed. Suggested change: SDK helper in TS adds a `normalizeToolOutput(raw, schema, mode)` that does minimal safe transforms: unwrap single-element arrays, strip surrounding quotes if double-encoded, and fallback to original if not matching. Keep analytics event to track occurrences.
Mia: Perfect. Small PR will make samplekit pass. Can we also log a DX note in onboarding docs about why this happens? New users hit this and assume model is broken.
Tony: I'll draft the PR and a unit test. Patch plan: add normalize helper, wire into schema validation path, add telemetry `tool_coercion_applied=true/false`.
Kuan: Also check retry path — earlier we had a bug where auth/retry wrapper re-encoded JSON during a retry and turned objects into strings. That would break the normalizer detection. Add a test for retry double-encode.
Sam: Good call. Example test snippet: ```ts
// simulate retry wrapper double-encode
const raw = JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify({action: 'upsert', items: []}));
expect(normalizeToolOutput(raw, objSchema, 'loose')).toEqual({action: 'upsert', items: []});
```
Mia: I'll add a sampleapp integration test that mimics the older model returning an array. We should keep the default mode as `strict` for new users but samplekit opts into `loose`.
Tony: Filing issue + linking PR in the thread.
Tony: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/217 (WIP) — adds normalize helper + tests
Kuan: I'll monitor CI for flakiness and add a short blurb to the onboarding guide under "Structured output quirks".
Mia: Thanks team. This should cut onboarding friction for folks who copy sample code. :pray:
Sam: Nice. If anyone else sees weird schema errors in sampleapps, drop them here and we'll batch fixes.
CI-bot: build 4383 queued (will run once PR lands).
